summary: Phase 4 Green changes are structurally correct. Found and fixed 1 defect: the throws audit's detection regex (^\s*throw\b) missed 9 inline throw sites in 3 exported Convex wrappers that lacked @throws. Fixed by adding @throws tags to completePhase, skipPhase, and checkAndIncrementRateLimit. All guards pass, tsc clean.

findings.title: Throws audit regex misses inline throws — 3 functions lack @throws
findings.description: The Phase 4 throws audit's detection pattern (^\s*throw\b) only matches throw statements at line start, missing inline throws like 'if (!x) throw ...'. This left 3 exported Convex wrappers without @throws: student.ts completePhase (3 inline ConvexError throws), student.ts skipPhase (3 inline ConvexError throws), and rateLimits.ts checkAndIncrementRateLimit (2 inline throws). The audit claimed '0 throw sites without @throws after Green' based on incomplete enumeration.
findings.fix: Added @throws tags to all 3 functions' JSDoc blocks. Updated phase-4-throws-audit.md to reflect corrected throw site count (81 total, up from 72) and document the inline-throw detection gap.

findings.title: Vitest suite times out in sandbox (>120s)
findings.description: The full vitest suite exceeds the 120s timeout in this environment. tsc --noEmit passes clean. The exported-surface guard and typed-params guard both pass. This is an environment limitation, not a code defect.
findings.fix: N/A — environment constraint, not a code issue.
